textureVariants: GLBs reference the 1k KTX2 files by relative uri. Quality tiers that want 2k rewrite "_1k.ktx2" to "_2k.ktx2" in a LoadingManager URL modifier; every texture has both files.
customAttributes: three.js GLTFLoader lower-cases custom attributes: _FIN_MASK is geometry attribute "_fin_mask" (0 rigid body, 1 fin tip) and _FIN_ID is "_fin_id" (0 body, 1 caudal, 2 dorsal, 3 anal, 4 pectoral, 5 pelvic). Anemone tentacle sway is "_sway" (0 base, 1 tip). Shrimp reuse _fin_id (0 body, carapace and eyes; 6 walking leg; 7 antenna; 8 pleopod; 9 abdomen, telson and tail fan) and add "_leg" (limb index: pair * 2 + side, side 0 = -x; antennules 0/1, long antennae 2/3; tail-fan leaves k * 2 + side). Shrimp _fin_mask means: id 0 is 0 (eye stalks included, ignore it); ids 6 and 7 are the weight along the limb, 0 root to 1 tip; id 8 is the pleopod beat weight, 0 root to 1 tip; id 9 is the tail-curl weight clamp((hingeZ - z) / (hingeZ - telsonZ), 0, 1) of the rest position. Tail curl rotates ids 8 and 9 about +x through the shrimp.abdomenHinge {y, z} by flex * clamp((hingeZ - z) / (hingeZ - telsonZ), 0, 1), computed from the rest position, never from _fin_mask, so the pleopods follow the segment they hang from. Pleopods (id 8) exist only in LOD0 and LOD1 and are removed from LOD2; legs are simplified, so do not assume every _leg index exists at every LOD. The cherry material is alphaMode BLEND with base colour alpha 0.86: three.js GLTFLoader turns depthWrite off for BLEND, so set depthWrite true on the cherry material and expect some sorting artefacts from the self-overlapping legs and antennae.
